title: DC-RESEARCH-LAB-01 Research Lab entity schema (lab.v1, r4: user decisions 00:21 + 00:26 + 00:30 IST)
description: Catalog record schema for the Research Lab. Fail-closed: additionalProperties=false and every property required (no silent defaults). Observation is a Parquet row schema; Edge and Event are structural records. Design artifact only - not wired to any code. r2: UD-1 DuckDB catalog; UD-2 holdout budget per (search_family_id, hypothesis_id); UD-3 required per-metric reproduction_tolerance (no default). r3: UD-4 DecimalString/HashSafeJSON for hashed numerics; UD-5 LabManifest gc_grace_days=30; UD-6 required versioned survival_policy + minimum_criteria; UD-7 post-hoc criteria flagged, never minimum. r4: UD-8 ObservationSet ARCHIVED state + archive_uri; UD-9 READ events require consumer_id; UD-10 DECIDED 2026-09-28 01:12 IST (Dataset.transform for DERIVED: source_hash + transform_code_hash + declared params); Q7 DECIDED (UD-11, 2026-09-28 01:24 IST): PARALLEL_COMPARISON with exactly four corrections; survival governance ALL_FOUR_PASS (UD-12, 2026-09-28 01:27 IST). r9: UD-13 Dataset.usage_class FULL|SMOKE (required); Evidence.smoke_only; SURVIVING forbidden with SMOKE lineage.

ContentId.description: sha256 over RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the entity's identity_inputs (immutable fields + parent ids), prefixed 'sha256:'.

HumanId.description: Human-readable alias (e.g. run_20260916_172925, HYP-20260928-001, F-112). Unique per entity_type; NEVER part of any hash.

TrustStatus.description: Fail-closed: UNKNOWN is treated exactly like FAIL by every gate/query. Never defaults to PASS.

LifecycleState.description: Mutable projection only; derived from the event log, never stored as source of truth in the entity row.

Hypothesis.description: Preregistered claim. Identity inputs: all fields above except human_id. Frozen at REGISTERED (event seq proves precedence over any Run).

FalsificationCriterion.description: Falsification criterion. UD-4: threshold is DecimalString. UD-7: post_hoc=false + added_at_event_seq=null for preregistered criteria (inside Hypothesis); post_hoc=true + added_at_event_seq (CRITERION_ADDED event seq) for CriterionAddendum criteria.

SearchFamily.description: Multiple-testing ledger root. UD-11 (Q7 decided 2026-09-28 01:24 IST): all four corrections run in parallel, each producing its own Measurement/Evidence; never merged into one verdict. Every Hypothesis/variant tested (incl. killed) counts toward realised family size.

correction_mode.description: UD-11 (2026-09-28 01:24 IST): only active mode. SINGLE_DECLARED retired (history in the card; no lab records exist yet, so removal breaks no stored history).

corrections.description: UD-11: exactly the four methods BONFERRONI, HOLM, BH_FDR, WHITE_RC_SPA, each exactly once, each with declared alpha. Sorted by method for hashing.

Experiment.description: Frozen design testing exactly one Hypothesis. Identity inputs: hypothesis_id + design.

Configuration.description: Fully-resolved declared config. Identity = sha256(JCS({kind, config_schema_id, resolved})). defaults_applied MUST be empty; a missing required key is a validation REJECT (fail-closed). cost_model_id == config id of kind COST_MODEL. UD-4: resolved must be HashSafeJSON (no JSON floats; decimals as DecimalString).

CodeIdentity.description: Pinned code. Identity inputs: all fields. dirty must be false (dirty tree = run REJECTED).

Dataset.description: Market authority = MT5 OHLCV. Identity: MT5_OHLCV = sha256(JCS({source,symbol,timeframe,broker_server,manifest sorted by rel_path})); DERIVED (UD-10, decided 2026-09-28 01:12 IST) = sha256(JCS({source,symbol,timeframe,transform})) with manifest as bit-exact output witness. Derived M15 must come from M5 (source_timeframe=M5), never mixed with vendor/raw M15; Excel is not a source. derived_from_dataset_ids=[transform.source_hash] and derivation_code_id=transform.transform_code_hash (cross-record check). clock_review is an attribute, not identity; unreviewed clock => QUARANTINED. UD-13: usage_class (FULL|SMOKE) is required and an identity input. XAUUSD FULL = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv (raw MT5_OHLCV); XAUUSD SMOKE = data/XAUUSD_mt5_1month_latest.csv (QUARANTINED tz_unreviewed until user review).

FeatureSchema.description: Column contract for Observations (names, dtypes, units, point-in-time lag). Identity = sha256(JCS(columns sorted by name)).

MetricDefinition.description: Reusable metric definition (Metric entity, definition side). Identity = sha256(JCS(all fields)). UD-3: reproduction_tolerance is required and part of identity inputs (changing tolerance = new MetricDefinition id).

Run.description: One execution. derivation_id = sha256(JCS(inputs + experiment_id)); id = sha256(JCS({derivation_id, attempt_seq})). Reproduction = new Run, same derivation_id; reproducible iff output_manifest_hash equal.

input_checks.description: holdout_untouched (UD-2): no prior HOLDOUT_ACCESS for this run's (search_family_id, hypothesis_id) pair on its holdout datasets; UNKNOWN = FAIL.

output_manifest_hash.description: UD-3: hash of the manifest of object hashes (ObservationSets, Artifacts) only - bit-exact; metric values are excluded and checked under tolerance.

ObservationSet.description: Physical unit of Observations. id = derivation_id-scoped: sha256(JCS({derivation_id})); content_hash = sha256 over canonical row stream (sorted by observation_key). Eviction keeps row; rematerialisation must reproduce content_hash. UD-8: storage_state/archive_uri/archived_at_event_seq are storage projections (excluded from identity). ARCHIVED requires archive_uri + archived_at_event_seq; same content_hash; RESTORED keeps the archive_uri as provenance. EVICTED forbidden while a SURVIVING Finding depends on the set (cross-record lineage check).

Observation.description: Parquet row (not a catalog entity). Extra columns governed by FeatureSchema; additionalProperties allowed only for FeatureSchema columns (validated against it).

Measurement.description: Metric value over an ObservationSet slice. Identity inputs: observation_set_id, metric_def_id, slice_config_id, split, cost_model_config_id (NOT value; value is verified by recompute).

Evidence.description: Sealed bundle of Measurements answering a declared test. Identity = sha256(JCS({hypothesis_id,test_declaration,measurements sorted,family_accounting,artifact_ids sorted})). Shared by many Findings.

family_accounting.description: UD-11: one correction per Evidence; four Evidence records per test (one per method). correction must match one of the SearchFamily's four (cross-record check).

smoke_only.description: UD-13: true iff any Dataset in this Evidence's ancestor lineage has usage_class SMOKE (lineage check). smoke_only Evidence never counts toward SURVIVING.

Finding.description: Recorded knowledge. Identity = sha256(JCS({hypothesis_id,claim,claim_scope,evidence sorted,supersedes_finding_id})). economic_claim_eligible (was economic_claims_allowed) is a derived research flag; UNKNOWN != PASS; confers no production authority. UD-6: survival_policy + minimum_criteria are identity inputs; survival_projection is a projection excluded from identity.

minimum_criteria.description: UD-6/UD-7: non-empty subset of the Hypothesis's PREREGISTERED criteria. post_hoc must be false (post-hoc criteria can never be minimum). Under ALL_DECLARED_CRITERIA must list every preregistered criterion (cross-record check).

survival_projection.description: UD-6 PROJECTION (excluded from identity, like lifecycle state): declared criteria not yet tried, as of the latest SURVIVAL_EVALUATED event.

Falsification.description: First-class attempt to kill a Finding. Identity = sha256(JCS({finding_id,criterion_id,kind,plan})). outcome is written once (event CONCLUDED); VOID if plan declared after any of its runs started or holdout already touched. UD-2: kind OOS_PINNED_SHA requires plan.holdout_scope = (search_family_id, hypothesis_id) of the target Finding's Hypothesis; VOID if a HoldoutAccess with access_ordinal>=2 exists for that scope+holdout before conclusion.

post_hoc.description: UD-7: true iff criterion_id refers to a CriterionAddendum criterion. Post-hoc attempts can FALSIFY but never count toward SURVIVING.

Artifact.description: Any immutable blob in CAS. id = 'sha256:'+sha256(bytes). Trace (e.g. layer_trace PER_RUN_FILE) is kind TRACE.

Consumer.description: Read-only record of who reads Findings. No write path, no decision fields. Reads are logged as READ events. UD-9: registration is mandatory for every read of views/; reads by unregistered identities are rejected (READ_REJECTED).

Edge.description: Directed child->parent (derived -> source). Every edge is also implied by an id field inside src's identity inputs, so edges are immutable by construction and rebuildable. attributes: ReproductionRecord on REPRODUCES (UD-3), null on every other rel.

Event.description: Hash-chained log record. scope is required non-null for HOLDOUT_ACCESS (UD-2); payload must be a ReproductionRecord for REPRO_MATCH/REPRO_MISMATCH (UD-3).

DecimalString.description: UD-4 canonical decimal string: plain decimal, minimal form (no exponent, no '+', no leading/trailing zeros, no '-0'). One value = one hashable spelling. Used for EVERY non-integer value in any hashed field.

ReproductionTolerance.description: UD-3. REQUIRED on every MetricDefinition, NO default. EXACT = bit-exact (value must be "0"). ABSOLUTE: |obs-ref| <= value. RELATIVE: |obs-ref| <= value*max(|ref|,LabManifest.relative_tolerance_epsilon (0.000000000001)). Applies ONLY to Measurement values; ObservationSet content_hash, Artifact sha256 and Run output manifest hashes are always bit-exact.

ReproductionRecord.description: UD-3. REPRO_MATCH iff every bitexact_checks[].match == PASS AND every measurement_checks[].within == PASS (UNKNOWN = FAIL). tolerance is copied from the MetricDefinition at check time and recorded here. Stored as Edge.attributes on REPRODUCES and as the REPRO_* event payload.

HoldoutScope.description: UD-2 (CONFIRMED 2026-09-28 00:47 IST): holdout budget is scoped per (search_family_id, hypothesis_id) pair.

HoldoutAccess.description: UD-2. One record per read of a holdout Dataset. access_ordinal counts per (scope.search_family_id, scope.hypothesis_id, holdout_dataset_id). Only ordinal 1 is a valid OOS access; ordinal >= 2 VOIDs later OOS_PINNED_SHA attempts for THAT pair only. Identity = sha256(JCS({scope, holdout_dataset_id, run_id, access_ordinal})).

HashSafeJSON.description: UD-4: recursive JSON allowed in hashed payloads (Configuration.resolved): strings, integers, booleans, null, arrays, objects. Non-integral JSON numbers (floats) are rejected; encode them as DecimalString.

CriterionAddendum.description: UD-7: criterion added after the Hypothesis was REGISTERED. ALLOWED but FLAGGED (post_hoc=true, added_at_event_seq). Never changes the Hypothesis id; can never be in any Finding.minimum_criteria. Identity = sha256(JCS({hypothesis_id, criterion, reason})).

SurvivalPolicy.description: UD-6: declared, versioned survival policy. NO default (required wherever used). Current phase: DECLARED_MINIMUM. ALL_DECLARED_CRITERIA designed for later; switching = new policy_version, never retroactive.

survival_governance.description: UD-12 (2026-09-28 01:27 IST): SURVIVING only if all four corrections PASS, in addition to UD-6 minimum criteria and UD-7 post-hoc exclusion. UNDECIDED removed.

correction_results.description: UD-12: at most one result per method (duplicates rejected). For SURVIVING: exactly four, one per method, all PASS.

lineage_usage_classes.description: UD-13: set of usage_class values of all Datasets in the Finding's lineage (verified by lineage check). SURVIVING requires non-empty and FULL-only.

SurvivalEvaluation.description: UD-6/UD-12: payload of SURVIVAL_EVALUATED events. resulting_state SURVIVING requires correction_results with all four methods PASS (schema-enforced) AND all minimum criteria tried+survived with no post-hoc minimum (cross-record lineage check). Appended on every (re-)evaluation; never rewrites earlier evaluations.

LabManifest.description: Declared lab constants (not defaults): UD-1 catalog, UD-5 gc_grace_days=30, UD-3 epsilon. Missing key = invalid manifest.

ReadEventPayload.description: UD-9: every READ of views/ carries a REGISTERED consumer_id. Read-only; no write-back.

ReadRejectedPayload.description: UD-9: payload of READ_REJECTED (unregistered read attempt).

ArchiveEventPayload.description: UD-8: payload of ARCHIVED / RESTORED / ARCHIVE_RESTORE_VERIFY_FAILED.

CorrectionSpec.description: UD-11: one of the four mandatory parallel corrections, with an explicitly declared alpha (DecimalString, no default). WHITE_RC_SPA = White's Reality Check / Hansen SPA (one slot).

bar_boundary_anchor.description: Where target bars start (e.g. :00/:15/:30/:45 on the declared timezone clock). Must be declared; no default.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the bar clock. Must be declared; no default.

partial_bar_rule.description: What to do when a target bar lacks source bars. Must be declared; no default.

DerivationParams.description: UD-10: declared resampling parameters. Every key required; missing = schema-invalid (fail-closed).

DatasetTransform.description: UD-10: derivation record of a DERIVED Dataset. source_hash = content id of the source Dataset (MT5_OHLCV M5 for derived M15); transform_code_hash = CodeIdentity id of the resampling code. Identity input of the derived Dataset; no defaults.

CorrectionResult.description: UD-12: outcome of one parallel correction for the Finding's test. PASS/FAIL require the sealed Evidence id. MISSING/ERROR/UNKNOWN = not passed (fail-closed).

UsageClass.description: UD-13: declared dataset usage class; required, no default. SMOKE = fast/pipeline runs only; evidence from SMOKE lineage can never count toward SURVIVING.
